content: Customer Kiara Sen called to renew her expired auto insurance policy (SH-112233). Agent Vikram Singh processed the renewal for $1,080 using the credit card on file ending in 4242. The customer also requested to add a new driver, her brother Alex Sen, which increased the total premium to $1,200. The agent confirmed coverage details, explained that the renewal is effective from 10/01/2026 to 09/30/2027, and agreed to email the policy documents and renewal agreement for signature.

action_items: Email the new policy documents and renewal agreement to kiara.sen@example.com
Customer needs to sign and return the renewal agreement
